mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% in a month signals weakening labor market strength, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 5.5% in the trigger month, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) signals robust demand-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate signals higher policy rates, elevating borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS rising in the tightening regime, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side activity, indicating stronger manufacturing output and corporate confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in housing-related activity (HOUST) above 1000 units in a month signals a rebound in housing market demand, stimulating construction and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-positive despite HOUST crossing above 1000 units, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant positive effect.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in labor participation (PAYEMS) and unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a labor market in transition, potentially signaling reduced job growth and weaker consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate signals further monetary accommodation, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-positive despite FEDFUNDS falling in the late-cycle regime, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant positive effect.
